title: PCT25: phase-compressed robust threshold search with linear qubits

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE PCT25 physical implementation in proof.md has unconditional entire-secret success at least95/128. It acquires exactly k=2^16(n+16) original copies sequentially from the passive fixed joint bank; epsilon=1/4 under the exact fixed-bad-set arbitrary-extension model with ideal-product good marginal. Every acquired register, retained row, classical record, descriptor and scratch/padding is counted; unread inaccessible source state is excluded by the rules. Label extraction is a local channel on arbitrary entangled inputs. Exact controlled compiled words preserve accumulator bits; record/candidate-dependent scalar phases cancel in the exact threshold reflection. Both true rejection and wrong acceptance are bounded before a mixed-state Grover telescoping argument. All four bounds hold jointly on every branch, including bad inputs, misdecodes, initialization and full cleanup. No source inverse/control, purification input, QRAM, free word arithmetic or uncharged rotation primitive is used. The full charged time is O(2^((1/2)n)n^2(log2n)^2) for n>=2, with n=1 separately finite, exact time growth index1. Each iteration has O(n^2 log(n+2)) actual core/generator bit operations and pays full allocated-memory addresses. The coefficient1/2 multiplies n, not sqrt(n).

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
